notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Most of the problems faced by players have been fixed.
We thank for the responses by our fellow player and will continue to address any issue one might face.

notes.title: Delay in Development
notes.notes: Due to cryptocurrency crisis, we're unable to procure new hardware to test run. We also noted a dip in game sales due to the same. We would like to thoroughly test the title and free it from bugs and such. There are a few issues to be addressed, we hope the cryptopocalypse will be a little less aggressive against the PC gaming community by April. Looking forward to an early release. Thank you for bearing with us.
